author_or_org: Tianqi Liu, Yandong Guan, Songze Li, Wenkai Wang, Gang Yu, Chengfei Lv

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Across 11 model-scaffold configurations, most benchmark scores fall between 52.1 and 78.1, and the highest complete-delivery rate is 14.0%.
claims.quote: Across 11 model--scaffold configurations, most scores fall between 52.1 and 78.1; GPT-5.6-Sol achieves the highest complete-delivery rate of 14.0\%.

claims.question: q1
claims.claim: Incomplete implementation and missing integration are the principal delivery bottlenecks; producing individual components does not ensure complete delivery.
claims.quote: Incomplete implementation and missing integration are the principal bottlenecks: producing individual components does not ensure a complete delivery.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The benchmark targets incremental PRD fulfillment, where issue resolution, development from scratch, and isolated tests leave important requirements underexplored or incompletely evidenced.
claims.quote: Issue resolution and development from scratch leave incremental PRD fulfillment underexplored, while isolated tests provide incomplete evidence of business and integration requirements.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: The benchmark measures PRD fulfillment by combining requirement reconstruction, criterion construction, and evidence-based evaluation.
claims.quote: It combines requirement reconstruction, criterion construction, and evidence-based evaluation to measure PRD fulfillment and connect delivery gaps to agent behavior.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The benchmark evaluation agrees with expert consensus 95.2% of the time and has lower case-level variation across judging records than across repeated executions.
claims.quote: Evaluation achieves 95.2\% agreement with expert consensus, with lower case-level variation across judging records than repeated executions.

claims.question: q6
claims.claim: Successive harness releases raised mean performance from 59.4 to 63.0 using the same model and task suite.
claims.quote: Beyond model comparison, the benchmark provides actionable feedback for harness refinement: diagnosis guides targeted improvements, and successive harness releases raise mean performance from 59.4 to 63.0 using the same model and task suite.
